description: PHIDU - Internet Access is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Torrens University Australia - Public Health Information Development Unit. This dataset, released August 2020, contains statistics on the population's access to the internet based on internet connection types (Dial-up, Broadband and 'Other'). The data is by Local Government Area (LGA) 2016 geographic boundaries. For more information please see the data source notes on the data. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Torrens University Australia - Public Health Information Development Unit. Its tags are HEALTH SCIENCES, Public health. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
